lines.trans: Viktor Petrovich, this guy will not work here!
Just a second, since when do you give orders here?
I am the restaurant art director and know our standards!
Senya, say loudly, who is the boss in this kitchen?
All the cooks know perfectly well that I am the boss here.
You are hiring the first random person from the street!
I alone decide who works in my kitchen!
You will regret this strange and foolish decision.
Rump, you are officially hired onto our restaurant staff!
You will work on a two-on, two-off schedule.
This is simply outrageous and completely unacceptable behavior!
And you can go command your waiters.
Create a wonderful atmosphere in the hall of our establishment!
